[WEBINAR]
Bouncing Back 2021 Playbook: Tips, Trends, and Strategies for Resilient Travel Companies
Register today and be the first to see the Playbook: <[[https://more.flywire.com/BouncingBackPlaybookWebinar.html?utm_source=em2]]>
2020 has challenged the travel industry like never before. But travel businesses are ready to bounce back! Flywire has compiled a playbook with the tips, trends, and strategies that will help members of the travel industry do just that. Areas of focus will include:
- Health & Safety Guidelines - Terms & Conditions - Travel Insurance - Diversifying Product Offerings - Social Media Marketing - Reducing Payment Costs
Join us for this live webinar <[[https://more.flywire.com/BouncingBackPlaybookWebinar.html?utm_source=em2]]> on Thursday, November 12 @ 12PM EST as we discuss the Playbook with a panel of travel industry experts. Register now and receive a free copy of the Playbook via email after the event.
Panelists: Nigel Hack - Founder, Madrid & Beyond Robert Sheldon - Owner & Manager, Sheldon Chalet Steve Rosset - Media & Marketing Director, Last Frontier Heliskiing
<[[https://more.flywire.com/BouncingBackPlaybookWebinar.html?utm_source=em2]]>
If you can't make the live webinar, please register, and we will share the recording and the full Playbook after the broadcast.
